headline: 50 killed, 500 injured in US airstrikes on southern Iran
summary: Iran has identified two teenage girls among the civilian casualties of a US strike on a bridge in the port of Khamir.
details: Iranian authorities report that at least 50 people were killed and over 500 others injured in US airstrikes across southern Iran.
The Iranian Embassy in India shared the photos and names of two teenage girls, Sogand Darmand and Fatemeh Zahra Akbari, who were among the civilian casualties.
The girls were killed when US forces struck a bridge in the port of Khamir on Thursday night.
According to reports, seven civilians were killed in the strike on the bridge in Khamir, including the two teenage girls.
The US strikes in Iran were ordered by Donald Trump following an Iranian missile and drone attack in Jordan that killed two US service members and one remains missing.
The tensions between the US and Iran continue to escalate as both nations engage in direct military action.

headline_marked: World Cup final [[tickets hit 7.4 million BDT]] as Argentina faces Spain
headline: World Cup final tickets hit 7.4 million BDT as Argentina faces Spain
summary: Special hospitality seats for the historic final are selling for up to $60,000, driven by the potential final appearance of Lionel Messi.
details: Tickets for the World Cup final have reached staggering prices, with some seats selling for as much as $60,000, or approximately 7.4 million BDT.
On FIFA's official website, the cheapest available tickets started at $6,411.25 (around 8 lakh BDT) but sold out within hours, with the lowest price then jumping to nearly $10,000.
Premium hospitality seats are the most expensive, while resale platforms like StubHub and SeatGeek show lower-bowl seats reaching nearly $35,000.
The high demand is fueled by the historic matchup between Argentina and Spain, marking the first time these two giants meet in a World Cup final.
Fans are particularly eager to see Lionel Messi, as this is likely his final World Cup match. Messi has contributed 8 goals and 4 assists so far in the tournament.
Argentina is fighting for its fourth World Cup title and aiming to become the first team since Brazil (1958 and 1962) to win consecutive championships.

Spain is seeking its second title since 2010. The match also serves as a delayed clash between the Copa America and Euro champions after a previous Finalissima was canceled due to conflict in the Middle East.
